new_producers.clos_chapelle: Domaine du Clos de la Chapelle
new_producers.moulin_aux_moines: Domaine du Clos du Moulin aux Moines
new_producers.philippe_le_hardi: Château Philippe le Hardi (Château de Santenay)

notes.x_corton_clos_des_marechaudes: Clos des Maréchaudes is a monopole of Albert Bichot's Domaine du Pavillon; the walled clos straddles grand cru and premier cru.
notes.x_corton_chaillots_blanc: Louis Latour controls over 90% of the production of Les Chaillots, centred on Château Corton-Grancey.
notes.x_beaune_clos_de_la_feguine: Clos de la Féguine is a monopole of Domaine Jacques Prieur.
notes.x_beaune_clos_de_l_ecu: Clos de l'Ecu is a 2.37 ha monopole of Domaine Faiveley, bought in 2003 from the heirs of Jaboulet-Vercherre.
notes.x_beaune_clos_des_avaux: The Hospices de Beaune acquired the Clos des Avaux through an exchange of vines with négociant Edouard Chanson in 1900.
notes.x_beaune_clos_saint_landry: Clos Saint-Landry is a monopole of Bouchard Père et Fils, acquired in its entirety in 1791.
notes.x_beaune_mignotte: Georges Noëllat has owned a small clos in La Mignotte as a monopole since 2016.
notes.x_beaune_sur_les_greves_clos_saint_anne: The walled Clos Sainte-Anne is bottled as a monopole by Maison Jaffelin.
notes.x_meursault_sous_le_dos_d_ane: Planted to Pinot Noir and sold as Blagny 1er Cru until 2002; now Chardonnay farmed by Domaine Leflaive.
notes.x_chambolle_carrieres: Felettig is the only producer to bottle Les Carrières, though it is not a monopole.
notes.x_chassagne_clos_pitois: Clos Pitois is a walled monopole of Domaine Roger Belland in the Morgeot sector, planted half to Pinot Noir and half to Chardonnay.
notes.x_chassagne_chapelle: The Clos de la Chapelle within Abbaye de Morgeot is a monopole of Domaine du Duc de Magenta, vinified by Louis Jadot.
notes.x_chassagne_murees: Clos des Murées is a monopole of Fontaine-Gagnard.
notes.x_corton_gc_basses_mourottes: Parts of Hautes and Basses Mourottes were promoted to grand cru in 1978.
notes.x_corton_gc_clos_des_meix: Clos des Meix is a monopole of Domaine Comte Senard.
notes.x_corton_gc_hautes_mourottes: Parts of Hautes and Basses Mourottes were promoted to grand cru in 1978.
notes.x_corton_gc_vigne_au_saint: Long held by Louis Latour (Clos de la Vigne au Saint); since 2009 Méo-Camuzet and Domaine des Croix also bottle it from former Belland vines.
notes.x_corton_gc_fietres: The Hospices de Beaune replanted its Fiètres parcel to Chardonnay in 2012 for its Corton Blanc Cuvée Docteur Peste.
notes.x_corton_gc_grandes_lolieres: Les Grandes Lolières was promoted to grand cru in 1978.
notes.x_corton_gc_languettes: Les Languettes is labelled Corton when planted to Pinot Noir and Corton-Charlemagne when planted to Chardonnay.
notes.x_corton_gc_paulands: The grand cru part of Les Paulands is about 1.05 ha, more than two-thirds of it owned by the Senard family.
notes.x_corton_gc_vergennes: A white-wine Corton climat; the Hospices de Beaune's Cuvée Paul Chanson comes from vines Paul Chanson bequeathed in 1974.
notes.x_gevrey_issarts: Clos des Issarts is a Faiveley monopole, bought in 2003 after a 50-year lease.
notes.x_gevrey_bossiere: La Bossière is a monopole of Harmand-Geoffroy, at the top of the Combe de Lavaux.
notes.x_gevrey_romanee: La Romanée is a premier cru monopole of Domaine des Varoilles.
notes.x_corton_micaude: La Micaude is a monopole of Capitain-Gagnerot.
notes.x_maranges_clos_de_la_boutiere: Bachelet-Monnot owns half of the Clos de la Boutière.
notes.x_monthelie_chateau_gaillard: Le Château Gaillard is one of Monthélie's smallest premiers crus at 48.57 ares.
notes.x_morey_clos_baulet: Domaine des Lambrays holds the largest share; the Cosson family kept part when they sold Lambrays.
notes.x_morey_sorbes: Domaine des Lambrays holds 1.15 ha here, including the 0.20 ha Clos Sorbè.
notes.x_nuits_chateau_gris: Château Gris is a monopole of Albert Bichot, sold under the Lupé-Cholet / Château Gris label; only the red is premier cru.
notes.x_corton_clos_berthet: Clos Berthet is a walled monopole of Dubreuil-Fontaine.
notes.x_corton_village_de_pernand: Village de Pernand is a monopole of Domaine Rapet.
notes.x_pommard_clos_de_la_commaraine: Clos de la Commaraine is a 3.75 ha monopole, now bottled under the Domaine de la Commaraine label.
notes.x_pommard_derriere_saint_jean: Derrière Saint-Jean is a monopole of Violot-Guillemard.
notes.x_pommard_boucherottes: Les Boucherottes (Pommard) is a monopole of Coste-Caumartin.
notes.x_pommard_croix_noires: Domaine de Courcel's 0.65 ha is more than half of the lieu-dit.
notes.x_puligny_clos_de_la_garenne: Duc de Magenta's 0.84 ha in the Clos de la Garenne is rented and vinified by Louis Jadot.
notes.x_santenay_clos_faubard: Clos Faubard is shared among three owners.
notes.x_savigny_bataillere: Clos de la Bataillère is an Albert Morot monopole of about 1.8 ha, part of which has been replanted to Chardonnay.
notes.x_savigny_champ_chevrey: Champ Chevrey is a 1.46 ha monopole of Tollot-Beaut, bought by the family in 1953.
notes.x_savigny_redrescul: Redrescul is a monopole of Doudet-Naudin.
notes.x_volnay_clos_de_la_barre: Clos de la Barre is a Louis Jadot monopole, farmed under a long-term lease from a Parisian family.
notes.x_volnay_clos_de_la_cave_des_ducs: Clos de la Cave des Ducs is bottled as a monopole by Benjamin Leroux.
notes.x_volnay_clos_de_la_chapelle: Clos de la Chapelle is a monopole of Domaine du Clos de la Chapelle.
notes.x_volnay_clos_de_la_rougeotte: Clos de la Rougeotte is a monopole of Domaine François Buffet.
notes.x_volnay_clos_de_l_audignac: Clos d'Audignac is a monopole of Domaine de la Pousse d'Or, named after the Audignac family who owned the estate in the late 1800s.
notes.x_volnay_clos_du_chateau_des_ducs: Clos du Château des Ducs is a monopole of Domaine Michel Lafarge.
notes.x_volnay_clos_du_verseuil: Clos du Verseuil is a monopole of Domaine Y. Clerget, owned by the family since 1936.
notes.x_volnay_fremiets_clos_de_la_rougeotte: Frémiets Clos de la Rougeotte is a Bouchard Père et Fils monopole of about 0.44 ha.
notes.x_meursault_caillerets: Domaine des Clos is listed with 1.21 ha, more than the whole climat (1.02 ha); its area is left out until a source agrees.
notes.x_nuits_la_perriere_noblot: Machard de Gramont was listed with 1.7 ha from a merchant page, more than the whole climat (0.64 ha); area left out.
notes.x_maranges_clos_de_la_fussiere: Xavier Monnot is listed with 1.01 ha, more than the clos measures (0.89 ha); area left out.
